verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs state they include interactive widgets for exploring and testing the Core API directly from the browser. These sit alongside per-endpoint reference pages (cards, card transitions, users, card products) and a sandbox environment for running calls safely. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the runnable examples themselves (code samples, languages, request builders), independent or hands-on corroboration that the widgets work, and a publicly retrievable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
